newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada conducted a round of special purchase and resale agreements at 3.25 percent, confirming its target ceiling for Canada's call loan rate, traders said.
The central bank intervened to add liquidity to the money market after the call loan rate was trading at about 3.15 percent this morning, traders said. The bank's range is 2.75-3.25 percent.
The overnight financing rate traded at 2.95-3.05 percent after the bank's intervention, a trader said.
